atAGlance: Bún bò Nam Bộ is southern beef noodle salad, usually with warm beef, herbs, peanuts, fried shallots, and sweet-tart fish sauce.
whatItIs: Bún bò Nam Bộ is a southern dry noodle bowl with warm beef, herbs, peanuts, fried shallots, and sweet-tart fish-sauce dressing. It tastes best once everything is mixed through the noodles.
howToEnjoy: Toss the warm stir-fried beef through the cool vermicelli with herbs, bean sprouts, peanuts, fried shallots, and fish-sauce dressing. The bowl should taste smoky, nutty, fresh, and tangy at once.
howLocalsOrder: Order bún bò Nam Bộ when you want beef without broth. Ask for no peanuts or nước chấm on the side before the bowl is tossed.
worthKnowing: Despite the name, this is not bún bò Huế. It is a dry southern-style beef vermicelli bowl where texture and dressing do the work.
goodToKnow: The fish-sauce dressing goes over the bowl and gets tossed through the noodles, herbs, beef, peanuts, and fried shallots. Pour gradually if you want more control over sweetness and salt.
